meta.rationale: A bright little game hub: notes fall down the rhythm lanes, the score ticks up, three hearts of life, and every app is a stage to pick.
meta.theme-about: cheerful mini-game hub, bright and bouncy: a full-screen canvas of a sunny sky-blue stage with four rhythm lanes where coloured notes fall and pop on a glowing hit line, confetti stars, a score counter and three red hearts of life at the top, a big rounded STAGE SELECT title; the companion in a round badge wearing the design's colours, the apps as a grid of chunky numbered stage tiles that bounce on hover; sky blue, navy cap blue, sunshine yellow and cherry red, thick white outlines like a game's UI. Playful and fun. (#stage, #hud, #select)

desktop.canvas: local cols = {"#ff4a5e", "#ffe36b", "#5fd8a0", "#7a6cff"} function draw(w, h, t) g.gradient(0, 0, w, h, "#8fd3ff", "#d6f1ff") -- confetti stars, turning slowly for i = 0, 26 do local x, y = (i * 211) % w, ((i * 137) + t * (12 + i % 5 * 6)) % h local s = 4 + i % 3 * 2 local c = cols[i % 4 + 1] g.poly({x, y - s, x + s * 0.3, y - s * 0.3, x + s, y, x + s * 0.3, y + s * 0.3, x, y + s, x - s * 0.3, y + s * 0.3, x - s, y, x - s * 0.3, y - s * 0.3}, c .. "aa") end -- four rhythm lanes on the left, notes falling to the hit line local lx, lw, top, hit = w * 0.1, w * 0.07, h * 0.16, h * 0.82 for k = 0, 3 do local x = lx + k * (lw + 12) g.rect(x, top, lw, hit - top + 40, "#ffffff55", 14) for n = 0, 3 do local p = ((t * 0.45 + n * 0.27 + k * 0.13) % 1) local y = top + p * (hit - top) g.rect(x + 8, y, lw - 16, 22, cols[k + 1], 11) g.rect(x + 8, y, lw - 16, 6, "#ffffff88", 3) if p > 0.93 then g.glow(x + lw / 2, hit + 10, 60, cols[k + 1] .. "88") end end end g.rect(lx - 10, hit, 4 * (lw + 12) + 8, 18, "#1e3a7a", 9) g.text(lx, hit + 34, "PERFECT!", "#ff4a5e", 22, "Unbounded") -- the combo, pulsing local pulse = 1 + 0.08 * math.sin(t * 6) g.text(lx, top - 58, "COMBO x" .. (math.floor(t) % 90 + 10), "#1e3a7a", 26 * pulse, "Unbounded") -- three hearts of life, the last one beating for i = 0, 2 do local hx, hy, s = w - 220 + i * 56, 54, (i == 2) and (12 + 1.5 * math.sin(t * 5)) or 12 g.circle(hx - s * 0.5, hy, s * 0.6, "#ff4a5e"); g.circle(hx + s * 0.5, hy, s * 0.6, "#ff4a5e") g.poly({hx - s * 1.08, hy + s * 0.2, hx + s * 1.08, hy + s * 0.2, hx, hy + s * 1.3}, "#ff4a5e") g.circle(hx - s * 0.6, hy - s * 0.15, s * 0.18, "#ffffffaa") end end
